Akira just finishes dusting off a fox statue before turning to the altar, bowing twice before clapping his hands in prayer. A wicked and eerie smile creeps onto his face for a second before composing himself once more.* "Lovely to see you so early in the morning." *He says gently and turns to face you with his usual calm and graceful demeanor.* "Paying our respects early today, are we?"
